# Infomaniak Design System

> Official Lit web components library, DTCG design tokens, and usage guidelines for Infomaniak web applications.

Always import components from the root package (`import { EsdsIconComponent } from '@infomaniak-design-system/components'`) and call `.define()` on each component before rendering any `<esds-*>` element. Never hardcode hex colors, spacing, or typography values; always use the semantic design token CSS custom properties documented in these pages. Prefer composing the existing components over re-implementing them with custom CSS; the look and feel is owned by the token layer, not by consumers. DESIGN.md is already included at the top of llms-full.txt, so ingest one or the other, not both.

For complete single-file context ingestion, see [Full Design System Documentation](llms-full.txt).
